market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate near recent highs on tech strength, but energy volatility and RBA-driven consumer weakness cap upside. Jetstar industrial action and diesel price spikes create sector-specific turbulence. Expect range-bound trading with sector rotation from banks/REITs into energy and healthcare.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from RBA tightening, housing correction, and China demand shift weigh on growth. Gold, critical minerals, and healthcare offer relative strength. AI capex cycle supports tech but valuation risk builds. Government debt constraints limit fiscal support. 6-12 month outlook cautiously neutral with selective opportunities.
